descriptions.shortDescription: Kanban-based project and task management for Nextcloud.
descriptions.longDescription: Planninq is a kanban-based project and task management application for Nextcloud. It enables teams to visualise workflows, track progress on tasks and projects, and collaborate effectively. Built on Open Register, it integrates with the Nextcloud ecosystem and supports agile and lean work methodologies suitable for both government organisations and businesses. Conduction maintains this component at its own cost, committed until 31 December 2027.
features: Kanban board with configurable columns and WIP limits
Projects with team members and their own board
Tasks with priorities, labels, assignees and due dates
Backlog for unscheduled work, promoted to the board by drag and drop
Personal dashboard and my work overview
Time estimates, time entries and a personal timesheet
Task dependencies with a blocked badge on the card
Optional case references to link tasks and projects to Procest
All data stored as OpenRegister objects
NL Design System theming with CSS variables and WCAG AA

descriptions.shortDescription: Kanban-gebaseerd project- en taakbeheer voor Nextcloud.
descriptions.longDescription: Planninq is een kanban-gebaseerde project- en taakbeheertoepassing voor Nextcloud. Het stelt teams in staat om workflows te visualiseren, voortgang bij te houden op taken en projecten en effectief samen te werken. Gebouwd op Open Register integreert het met het Nextcloud-ecosysteem en ondersteunt agile en lean werkmethoden die geschikt zijn voor zowel overheidsorganisaties als bedrijven. Conduction onderhoudt dit component voor eigen rekening, toegezegd tot 31 december 2027.
features: Kanbanbord met configureerbare kolommen en WIP-limieten
Projecten met teamleden en een eigen bord
Taken met prioriteiten, labels, toegewezenen en deadlines
Backlog voor niet-ingeplande taken, met slepen naar het bord
Persoonlijk dashboard en overzicht van mijn werk
Tijdsinschattingen, tijdregistraties en een persoonlijk urenoverzicht
Afhankelijkheden tussen taken met een geblokkeerd-badge op de kaart
Optionele zaakreferenties om taken en projecten aan Procest te koppelen
Alle gegevens opgeslagen als OpenRegister-objecten
NL Design System-thema met CSS-variabelen en WCAG AA

metrics.name: Contributor Absence Factor
metrics.explanation: The fewest people who together made half of the commits on the default branch in the last 12 months, of the 100 contributors GitHub reports, among 4 human contributors. At 1 the project depends on a single person. Bots are left out; one person with several accounts or addresses counts more than once.

metrics.name: Organizational Diversity
metrics.explanation: Organisations are told apart by the email domain of the latest 300 commits of the last 12 months (269 commits by people, after the .mailmap) and, for a personal or hidden address, by the company on the author's public profile. The largest is conduction.nl (4 authors), with 100% of the 245 commits whose organisation is known; 9% of the commits come from 1 of 6 authors whose organisation stays unknown. Only these counts are kept, no names, addresses or companies; an organisation is named only when several authors share it.

metrics.name: Change Request Closure Ratio
metrics.explanation: 791 change requests were closed (merged or not) and 823 opened in the last 90 days, bots included. Below 1 the open backlog grows; above 1 it shrinks.

metrics.name: Time to First Response
metrics.explanation: None of the 15 latest change requests opened by people between 2026-08-22 and 2026-11-13 got a comment or review from anyone but its author.

metrics.name: Issue Response Time
metrics.explanation: None of the 2 latest issues opened by people between 2026-08-22 and 2026-11-13 got a comment from anyone but its author.

metrics.name: Release Frequency
metrics.explanation: 4 final releases were published in the last 12 months, about one every 91 days, counted from the GitHub releases. The latest final release is from 2026-08-30. Besides these, 1 pre-releases were published; they are not counted. Drafts and pre-releases are left out.
